observations: Replica creation succeeded for all four preexisting enabled source views: KEYS_ONLY, NEW_IMAGE, OLD_IMAGE, and NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES.
Each source retained its original StreamViewType and exact LatestStreamArn; DescribeStream on that original ARN remained ENABLED with its original view after replica creation.
Each us-east-2 replica inherited the enabled source StreamViewType rather than forcing NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES.

Real post-creation INSERT and MODIFY records were read through the public DynamoDB Streams API in both regions. KEYS_ONLY omitted both images. NEW_IMAGE supplied NewImage and omitted OldImage. OLD_IMAGE omitted NewImage and supplied OldImage on MODIFY; INSERT had no old image. NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES supplied NewImage on INSERT and both images on MODIFY.
The ordinary global-table stream-view-change control returned ValidationException at sequence 519: the table already has an enabled stream. Replica creation did not require changing that stream.
All four peers were removed before their source tables; ResourceNotFoundException verified absence for all eight regional tables. No IAM or service-linked-role mutation was requested.
limits: Four tiny on-demand MREC tables in account 000000000000, with one us-east-2 replica each; no MRSC, provisioned capacity, GSI, stream disable/re-enable, or other region claim.
One insert and one later update of a single item per case, with both regions' INSERT records observed before the update. This does not assert that rapid MREC writes cannot coalesce.

Record discovery used bounded polling of native shards from TRIM_HORIZON and stopped when the target event was found. Polling duration is not a replication-latency measurement; shard topology and record sequence identifiers are observations, not stable fixtures.

GetRecords responses use the public API Record/StreamRecord shape, not Lambda eventSourceARN envelopes. AWS CLI rendered timestamp values as ISO-8601 strings; signed DynamoDB calls retained numeric timestamps.
The replay uses NEW_IMAGE as the single representative nondefault inherited view; existing replication fixtures cover default NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES creation.
